scope: Official app-local Mihomo parsing, Android Keystore snapshots, actual unsafe AtomicFile .new deletion reproduction and formal encrypted publication barriers. Cross-JVM storage leases have a separate host gate. No public subscription, actual proxy connection or real account is used; live route application is verified separately.
